== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Hollow King]]’s Crown is a [[Forger technique]] associated with the [[Path of the Hollow King]], a path that utilizes [[pure madra]] to emphasize emptiness by diluting other properties. [[The crown]] manifests as shimmering black stars or blue-white jewels that hang in the air above a user's head. It serves as a specialized weapon used to combat powerful entities like [[Sages]]. While the crown is being forged, it can be supplemented by other techniques such as the [[Hollow King’s Mantle]] or the [[Hollow Spear|Hollow King’s Spear]].}}
